name: Ki Touch (Combat, Ki)
body:
Your focused ki guides your blow past your target’s defenses.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13, ki pool class feature or Ki Meditation, base attack bonus +6

Benefit(s): As a standard action, you can spend 1 point from your ki pool to resolve a single melee (or ranged) attack as a touch (or ranged touch) attack. By spending 2 points, you can use it as part of a charge action or as part of the same standard action as Vital Strike.
